我们对导管群的持续研究以及将恒星转化为红巨星的研究表明，我们或许能够扩大行动规模，直接使银河系核心过热，从而在整个银河触发热级联，把它改造成对我们更为适宜的环境。

我们已确定六个核心周边星系，可作为此计划的作业枢纽。这些星系位于星系超空间航路网络之外，但相关稳定虫洞的构建工作正紧锣密鼓进行。
texts.en:
Our ongoing research into Conduits and transforming stars into Red Giants suggests we may be able to scale up our operations to overheat the Galactic Core itself, triggering a thermal cascade across the entire Galaxy, thus transforming it into a much more hospitable place for us.

We have identified six systems surrounding the core that could serve as operational hubs for this endeavor. These systems lie beyond the galactic hyperlane network, but efforts are underway to generate stable wormholes and establish access.

label.zh: 只有我们适合在烈焰中生存。
label.en: We are the only ones fit to survive the flames.

tooltips.zh: 其他物种将试图反对我们。准备星系战争。
tooltips.en: Other species will try to oppose us. Prepare for Galactic war.

label.zh: 整个星系将在熊熊烈焰中归一。
label.en: The whole galaxy will blaze in harmony.
